## Purpose
A workflow run as it happens: overall progress, every step in order with its live state, where it failed and why, and when it is paused for a person.

## Responsibilities
- `LiveRunPanel` ("Run progress") renders `StepRow`s (`TypeChip`, `Preview`, `ErrorBox`) and fix actions (`FixStepButton`).
- Stop uses `executionsApi.cancel`: "Stop requested — the run will end after its current step."

## Key elements
`LiveRunPanel`.
